as_told.title: Doty doubled down on the L9 story on a podcast with Mario

plain: Mario Woods, an Air Force veteran who says he was taken by aliens, went on a podcast with Richard Doty, a former Air Force intelligence agent, and tried to question him. Woods says Doty was so protected by the hosts that it was hard to get a straight answer out of any of them. Michels tells it differently, saying Doty "kind of doubled down" on his account of a case known as the L9 incident.
